evaluation_rules.api_boundary: Frontend behaviour must be evaluated against the Phase 1 /chat contract.
evaluation_rules.business_logic: Frontend must not reproduce backend RAG, policy, eligibility, or escalation logic.
evaluation_rules.determinism: Prefer deterministic browser/component assertions over subjective visual evaluation.
evaluation_rules.scope: Evaluations must validate Phase 2 functionality only.

evaluations.name: Submit Customer Message
evaluations.scenario: Customer enters a non-empty support question and submits it.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: The message is sent to POST /chat and appears in the conversation.
failure_conditions: Message is submitted more than once

evaluations.name: Reject Empty Message
evaluations.scenario: Customer attempts to submit an empty or whitespace-only message.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: The frontend does not call the API.
assertions: Customer remains on the chat screen

evaluations.name: Render Grounded Answer
evaluations.scenario: Backend returns a normal grounded answer.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: The frontend displays the returned answer without changing its meaning.

mock_response.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days.

assertions: Response is represented as an agent message
Escalation state is not displayed as active
failure_conditions: Response is incorrectly shown as escalated

evaluations.name: Handle Successful API Response
evaluations.scenario: POST /chat returns HTTP success with a valid response.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Loading state ends and the response is displayed.
assertions: Input becomes available for another request

evaluations.name: Handle API Failure
evaluations.expected_behaviour: A user-friendly error is shown and the customer can retry.
assertions: Raw backend stack trace is not visible

evaluations.name: Display Sources
evaluations.scenario: Backend returns one or more source citations.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Returned source metadata is displayed alongside the answer.

mock_response.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days.

evaluations.name: Present Escalation
evaluations.expected_behaviour: The customer is clearly informed that human assistance is required.

mock_response.answer: I’m unable to safely resolve this request automatically. Human assistance is required.

assertions: No false completion message is shown
failure_conditions: Escalation is presented as a normal completed transaction
Frontend claims the issue was resolved
Frontend claims a human reviewed the case

evaluations.name: Do Not Invent Escalation Actions
evaluations.scenario: Backend returns an escalation response without a ticket or notification field.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Frontend communicates escalation without claiming ticket creation, email, or human review.
failure_conditions: Frontend claims support has been notified
Frontend claims a human has reviewed the request

evaluations.name: Prevent Duplicate Submission
evaluations.scenario: Customer submits a message and attempts to submit it again before the first request completes.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Only one API request is made while the request is pending.
assertions: Only one POST /chat request is generated

evaluations.name: Recover After API Error
evaluations.scenario: The first request fails and the customer retries.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: The customer can submit another request after the failure.
assertions: Retry generates a new API request
failure_conditions: Retry does not generate a request

evaluations.name: Responsive Chat Layout
evaluations.scenario: Customer uses the application at desktop and mobile-sized viewport widths.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Core chat functionality remains usable without horizontal overflow or inaccessible controls.
assertions: No required interaction depends on hover

evaluations.name: Keyboard Accessibility
evaluations.scenario: Customer uses keyboard navigation instead of a mouse.
evaluations.expected_behaviour: Customer can reach and operate the primary chat controls using the keyboard.
assertions: Message input can receive keyboard focus
